name: @substrat-run/connector-bolagsverket
description: Substrat connector: validates a Swedish organisation number against Bolagsverket's free value-datasets API (API för värdefulla datamängder): whether it exists, its registered name, legal form, address, SNI codes and whether it is active, deregistered, in liquidation or bankrupt. OAuth2 client credentials, throttled within the provider's 60 requests a minute. Host code, never module code.
